list.title: 🚨 Baby born in Germany? Up to €1,800 a month from the state – with a HIDDEN deadline
items: 🪪 Blue Card or work permit usually counts
💶 About 65% of your net pay, max €1,800
👫 Both parents take it = up to 14 months
📄 Birth certificate first – then apply fast
🇮🇳 No family here to remind you

blocks: Send it to someone expecting a baby
